title: Eight UG programs are accredited by NBA for three years - MGIT
content:
## Eight UG programs are accredited by NBA for three years

News Date : 05 Feb 2023News ReportGreetings from MGIT!We are Happy to inform that the following eight UG programs are accredited by NBA for three years.UG-Mechanical EngineeringUG-Civil EngineeringUG-Electrical & Electronics EngineeringUG-Metallurgical & Materials EngineeringUG-Computer Science & EngineeringUG-Electronics & Communication EngineeringUG-Information TechnologyUG-MechatronicsHeartiest congratulationsto Management, Principal, Vice Principal, HoDs, Directors, Faculty, Staff, Alumni, Employers, Students & Families for the trust, hardwork and outstanding achievements over the last few years which were considered for the assessments.Thank you for all the support!!!
Greetings from MGIT!We are Happy to inform that the following eight UG programs are accredited by NBA for three years.UG-Mechanical EngineeringUG-Civil EngineeringUG-Electrical & Electronics EngineeringUG-Metallurgical & Materials EngineeringUG-Computer Science & EngineeringUG-Electronics & Communication EngineeringUG-Information TechnologyUG-MechatronicsHeartiest congratulationsto Management, Principal, Vice Principal, HoDs, Directors, Faculty, Staff, Alumni, Employers, Students & Families for the trust, hardwork and outstanding achievements over the last few years which were considered for the assessments.Thank you for all the support!!!
Greetings from MGIT!We are Happy to inform that the following eight UG programs are accredited by NBA for three years.
- UG-Mechanical Engineering
- UG-Civil Engineering
- UG-Electrical & Electronics Engineering
- UG-Metallurgical & Materials Engineering
- UG-Computer Science & Engineering
- UG-Electronics & Communication Engineering
- UG-Information Technology
- UG-Mechatronics
Heartiest congratulationsto Management, Principal, Vice Principal, HoDs, Directors, Faculty, Staff, Alumni, Employers, Students & Families for the trust, hardwork and outstanding achievements over the last few years which were considered for the assessments.Thank you for all the support!!!
